mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_keys (user_id, team_id, key_name, api_key, permissions, rate_limit, created_at, expires_at, is_active) VALUES (#{userId}, #{teamId}, #{keyName}, #{apiKey}, #{permissions}, #{rateLimit}, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{isActive})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM api_keys WHERE api_key = #{apiKey} AND is_active = TRUE
SELECT * FROM api_keys WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM api_keys WHERE team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM api_keys ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE api_keys SET key_name = #{keyName}, permissions = #{permissions}, rate_limit = #{rateLimit}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE id = #{id}
